mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dialogue_run ( run_uid, request_id, session_id, owner_id, entry_agent, role_agent_id, role_agent_name, status, query_text, request_fingerprint, final_summary_text, llm_call_count, tool_call_count, artifact_count, prompt_tokens_total, completion_tokens_total, total_tokens_total, error_code, error_msg, started_at, deadline_at, heartbeat_at, finished_at, duration_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{runUid}, #{requestId}, #{sessionId}, #{ownerId}, #{entryAgent}, #{roleAgentId}, #{roleAgentName}, #{status}, #{queryText}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{finalSummaryText}, #{llmCallCount}, #{toolCallCount}, #{artifactCount}, #{promptTokensTotal}, #{completionTokensTotal}, #{totalTokensTotal}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE dialogue_run SET status = #{status}, final_summary_text = #{finalSummaryText}, llm_call_count = #{llmCallCount}, tool_call_count = #{toolCallCount}, artifact_count = #{artifactCount}, prompt_tokens_total = #{promptTokensTotal}, completion_tokens_total = #{completionTokensTotal}, total_tokens_total = #{totalTokensTotal}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0
UPDATE dialogue_run SET heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{runId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0

UPDATE dialogue_run SET status = #{terminalStatus}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN duration_ms ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{finishedAt}) DIV 1000 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0 AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= #{deadlineBefore} AND (heartbeat_at IS NULL OR heartbeat_at <= #{heartbeatBefore}) ORDER BY deadline_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchLimit}
